PUBLIC, BOARD & CEO COMMENTS & MEMORIAL ADJOURNMENTS

PUBLIC COMMENTS:

Ronald F. Owens Jr. - Oral re: Former Public Information Officer at California Department of Public Health
and COVID-19 vaccine whistleblower; Covid-19 vaccines disproportionately kill people of color at 2-times
the rate of white Americans; Fresno County noticed a 400% increase in fetal demise since administration of
Covid-19 vaccines and they also cause strokes and heart attacks in young people in their 20's; the vaccines
are not safe or effective; Board has the responsibility legally and morally to inform residents

David Duran - Oral re: Challenges for unhoused individuals from the predicted El Nino severe weather
events that will create serious public health and humanitarian emergencies for people sleeping outdoors who
need a safe dry place to go; the public is not seeing any steps taken to remedy and Supervisors never or
rarely acknowledge the suffering of the unhoused on the streets; the County has the regional system and
partnerships needed to make things happen but lacks the political will to do so; need a funded Countywide
weather shelter before the next extreme weather emergency

Pat Goodman - Oral re: Advocate for homeless and behavioral health services and affordable housing; need
for public awareness of emergency shelter options for unhoused individuals during severe weather events
including El Nino expected this winter

Gigi Jackson - Oral re: Huntington Beach resident and volunteer for Homeless United of Huntington Beach
and is NAACP Orange County Branch Secretary; here to advocate for the unhoused to provide Countywide
emergency shelter to protect health and safety during severe weather; County has no effective plan in place
which puts health and safety at risk

Jenny Braithwaite - Oral re: Represents Homeless United of Huntington Beach; reminding the County of the
duty to protect residents and provide shelter for unhoused people during dangerous weather; responsibility
should not be left to the cities, non profits and faith communities; the County should use existing
connections, partnerships and providers to identify facilities and create a coordinated response to provide
emergency shelter

Alice Soto - Oral re: Member of Homeless United of Huntington Beach; proposed three models for
emergency housing during weather emergencies and during El Nino this winter; find providers and
resources through the Commission to Address Homelessness

Ian Jameson - Oral re: Warning against the rapid expansion of massive data centers and roll out of 6g
control grids is not about infrastructure but are instead the digital scaffolding for a global tracking system of
human and financial activity and the creeping advancement of a data surveillance state; get ready for
Billionaires war against humanity

Steve Rocco - Oral re: No recognition of Columbus Day; book given to him in elementary school "Black
Like Me" teaching how people were treated differently; job applications include question on race and white

Pat Davis - Oral re: Member of Housing is a Human Right OC and supports emergency shelter for the

BOARD COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Foley - Oral re: In response to public comments regarding homelessness and adverse weather
events and highlighted rapid housing efforts during weather incidents and noted that each city has their own
plan and there is no one-size approach and the only real solution is more housing and bringing more permanent
supportive housing units online; the County has done a lot to build a system of care over the last 7 years and
